note: WAEC Civic Education Paper 1 round 1 (Round 16e): the WASSCE civic syllabus with FRESH angles and phrasings - scenario-led items (Musa's change, the held suspect, the Italy job promise), applied stems and question-form rewordings throughout, because the near-dup scan checks every item against the JAMB, WAEC and NECO banks INCLUDING our own 246-item NECO Civic bank on the same syllabus. Topics: values, citizenship and nationalism, national symbols, human rights, law and order, responsible parenthood, traffic regulations, cultism, drugs and drug abuse, HIV/AIDS, human trafficking, youth restiveness and empowerment, national unity, political apathy.
